Cc: tbaker@vendorco.io
Date: 2027-05-04T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Question on Redwood PO requirement for pilot

Hi Sergio —

Thanks for the warm welcome earlier. One quick operational question as we prepare paperwork for the pilot: our internal purchasing requires a PO for any vendor over $2,000, but our billing system can also accept monthly invoices if a temporary exception is on file. Can Redwood allow VendorCo to start the 6-week pilot under a conditional invoice path (monthly invoice, Net30) while procurement completes vendor setup? If not, what evidence or forms would you need to grant a temporary no-PO allowance?

Attached: VendorCo_W9.pdf and our standard procurement contact info.

Appreciate quick guidance — we’d like to avoid blocking the kickoff next week.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Ops | VendorCo

From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@vendorco.io>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-04T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Question on Redwood PO requirement for pilot

Lena —

Thanks for the heads up and the W9. Short answer: we can accommodate a temporary invoice-only path for a bounded pilot, but Procurement needs a short checklist of evidence and a signed SOW/commitment to avoid open-ended exposure. I’ve looped in Priyom and Naomi from procurement/ops to confirm the exact artifacts. Proposed checklist we typically ask for:

- Completed vendor questionnaire (I’ll send the template)
- W9 or country-equivalent (received)
- Signed SOW or engagement letter specifying pilot scope and spend cap
- Point-of-contact for billing and remittance

If Redwood Procurement signs off, we’ll create a time-limited exception (6–8 weeks) and route invoices to our AP queue with Net30. If Procurement requires a PO, they’ll need us to hold off on provisioning until PO is issued.

Can you return a signed SOW draft and the completed questionnaire by EOD Wednesday? That’ll let us fast-track the exception if Procurement approves.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the pilot live.

— Sergio Alvarez
Senior Account Lead | Redwood Inference

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, lena.ortiz@vendorco.io
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-04T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Question on Redwood PO requirement for pilot

Hi all — quick operational note from Procurement side. We can grant a limited invoice-only onboarding lane for pilots under the following conditions: 1) signed SOW with a spend cap not to exceed $10k for the pilot period, 2) completed Procurement_Questionnaire, 3) vendor onboarding form with remittance details, and 4) an internal approver (Sales Ops or AE) to accept the exception and own the exposure.

If VendorCo provides those, I’ll prepare an internal PO-waiver approval packet and a temporary account flag that marks invoices for expedited review. The waiver will explicitly expire after the pilot end date unless we convert to a standard PO-backed contract.

Lena — I attached the questionnaire template in a follow-up (see attachments) — please populate and return ASAP. Grace, can you confirm the SOW template we want VendorCo to sign (I suggested the standard pilot SOW with pilot deliverables + cap)?

Thanks,
Priyom
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@vendorco.io>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: tbaker@vendorco.io
Date: 2027-05-05T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Question on Redwood PO requirement for pilot

Thanks Priyom — attaching completed Procurement_Questionnaire_VendorCo.xlsx and a signed SOW_Draft_VendorCo.docx (electronic signature by our CEO). We noted the proposed spend cap at $8,500 for the 6-week pilot. Remittance details included in the questionnaire.

On the SOW: we included two milestones (kickoff + platform integration check) and a clause that invoices will be issued monthly Net30.

If Procurement needs anything else (bank verifier, certificate of insurance), let us know and we’ll prioritize. We’d prefer to avoid waiting for a formal PO if the waiver can be issued.

Best,
Lena

Hi team —

We reviewed the materials VendorCo returned. Everything needed for a limited exception is present (W9, completed questionnaire, signed SOW with $8.5k cap, remittance info). I’ve approved a 7-week invoice-only exception window starting 2027-05-10 through 2027-06-28. Conditions of the exception:

- Exception is time-boxed; no additional services or spend allowed beyond the SOW without a PO.
- AP will accept monthly invoices with reference "VendorCo Pilot — Redwood"; invoices go to ap@redwood.ai and will be processed Net30.
- VendorCo must provide any requested COI or bank-verification docs within 3 business days if AP flags payment hold.
- Sales Ops (Sergio) is the internal approver owning the exposure; Procurement (Priyom/Naomi) reserves the right to revoke if risk indicators surface.

I’ve created the internal waiver packet (HS-00429) and will upload it to the Deal record. Lena: please confirm you received the waiver email and that you’ll route invoices to ap@redwood.ai as described.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Procurement | Redwood Inference
